atoms.sound: Good morning Dr Morris. We have two patients this morning - Dhroov and Reece. Dhroov is 15 years old and is experiencing a fever, a cough, and a sore throat. Reece is a 16 year old. He has a stomach ache that won’t go away, a headache, and severe back pain.

b.sound: Hello doctor. I’m not feeling so good this morning. My temperature is really high and I’m coughing all the time. I’m sweating on and off and my throat is sore too.
Hey doctor. My stomach is in a lot of pain. I feel really tired and even a bit dizzy. I have no appetite, and I even feel like I might throw up.
Hi doctor. My nose is really blocked, and I keep sneezing all the time. My head hurts, and I can’t sleep well at night. I also have a sore throat and feel very weak.

atoms.sound: Okay Noor. You need to take some medicine for the fever and cough. Make sure to get a lot of rest until you get better. I could also give you some more pills to stop your throat from hurting so much.

atoms.a: What two things does Noor need to do for her fever and cough?
b: She needs to eat something healthy.

atoms.a: What can the doctor do for Noor’s sore throat?
b: ++She can give her some pills for the pain.
She can recommend her to a surgeon.
She can send her to the hospital.

b.sound: Hello doctor. I’m experiencing really painful headaches. I feel a bit dizzy, really tired, and it’s hard for me to concentrate on things.
Hi doctor. My stomach is really hurting and I feel like I could be sick  any minute. I have no appetite at all.
Hello doctor. My throat is sore, and I’m coughing non-stop. My temperature is high, and I keep sweating at night.

atoms.sound: Well, it sounds like you have a migraine, so it’s best if you stay at home for a while and rest. Take a few days off from school and make sure you don’t do any physical activities.
